description: This file defines the PartyContentWrapper class, which implements the ContentWrapper interface to facilitate rendering and retrieving party-related content within the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for fetching content by type, ID, and locale, with caching mechanisms to optimize performance.

classes.name: PartyContentWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class providing methods to access and render party-related content, with caching and content retrieval functionality.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the party content as a string for a given content type, with optional caching and encoding.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the content ID for a specific content type associated with the party.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Returns a list of content texts for a specific content type.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Fetches specific content by its ID, with options for caching and encoding.

methods.name: getPartyContentAsText
methods.description: Static method to retrieve party content as text, given various parameters including locale and dispatcher.

methods.name: getFirstPartyContentByType
methods.description: Finds the most recent party content for a given party and content type, considering the date.
